defs.def: at any time that; on any occasion that 在任何 … 的时候；无论何时；在任何 … 的情况下

ex.s: The truth is that we are lucky enough to have clean water whenever we want, but this is not the case for many people around the world.
ex.t: 事实是，我们足够幸运，想要时就有干净的水，但世界上许多人并非如此。

ex.s: The app makes our practical language lessons available wherever and whenever.
ex.t: 这款应用程序让我们的实用语言课程随时随地可用。

defs.def: every time that 每当；每次

ex.s: Whenever I tell people that I teach English at the Berlin Zoo, I almost always get a questioning look.
ex.t: 每当我告诉别人我在柏林动物园教英语，几乎总会收获一个疑惑的眼神。

ex.s: Whenever I heard of businesses using plastic, I'd send an email.
ex.t: 每当我听说有企业使用塑料，就发一封邮件。

ex.s: You find it whenever people ask how you’re doing because they care, and not because they’re getting paid to do so.
ex.t: 当你发现人们问你“最近好吗”是因为他们在乎，而不是因为他们拿工资这么做时，你就能感受到它。

ex.s: Whenever I met one of them who seemed tome at all clear-sighted, I tried the experiment of showing him my Drawing Number One, which I have always kept.
ex.t: 每当我遇到一个在我看来还算清醒明智的人，我就试试给他看我一直保存的“一号画”，做那个实验。

ex.s: Whenever you make a choice, your character is reinforced, or changes, or grows, or diminishes, depending on whether the decision you made is wise or foolish, good or bad.
ex.t: 每当你做出选择时，你的品格就会得到加强、改变、成长或削弱，这取决于你做的决定是明智还是愚蠢，是好还是坏。

ex.s: You get a message whenever there has been an update.
ex.t: 每当有更新，你都会收到一条消息。

defs.def: 别的什么时候（也可以）；任何时间（都行）

ex.s: We can download software, documents, and images whenever we need them.
ex.t: 我们可以在需要时随时下载软件、文档和图片。

ex.s: You must come whenever you want and have whatever you like.
ex.t: 你想来随时可以来，喜欢什么尽管拿。
